meta.title: Pip at the Lake Festival
meta.textType: story: the gist of an illustrated story

paragraphs: Tom and Lily went to the lake festival, and Pip had a very wet day. The festival was in the park on Saturday. Many families came with small boats. The sun was hot, and the lake was green. Tom and Ben made a boat with Dad. It was blue and white. They wanted to sail it on the lake. "Shall we put it in the water?" asked Ben. "Yes, let's go," said Tom. Lily and Mia came with Pip.

The boat sailed across the water. It went to the middle of the lake. Tom stood on the grass, and the wind pushed the boat. Ben laughed and clapped. Pip watched the boat with big eyes. "Don't go into the water, Pip!" said Lily. But Pip jumped from the grass into the water. The water was not deep, but he was very small. Tom ran and lifted him out. Then Pip ran to the children, and his furry body made them wet.

Dad came with a big towel. He dried Pip, and Mia laughed. Pip drank some water from a bowl. "Pip is a furry puppy, not a fish," said Mia. Lily asked, "Shall we go to the swings now?" The swings were next to the lake. Lily and Mia sat on two swings. Tom and Ben pushed them high. Pip sat in Dad's arms and watched.

Later, Tom's boat sailed again, and this time Pip stayed on the grass. He lay down in the sun. Lily sat next to him and smiled. In the evening, the family walked home. Pip slept on the way. It was a wet day, but a happy day for everyone.
